subject: POC alignment: Veridian Health — success criteria & milestone calendar
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Lucas Barnett <lucas@veridianhealth.com>, Asha Patel <asha@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed milestone calendar (next steps)

Hi Lucas / Asha — thanks again for a productive call today. Short recap and a proposed timeline so we can lock the kickoff and owners. Please confirm or flag anything missing.

Quick recap of what we heard from Veridian:
- Goal: reduce triage time for intake summaries by surfacing structured notes + suggested coding tags (claims triage).
- Success criteria: 90% of suggested coding tags match SME judgement; <300ms 95th token latency for end-to-end request under test workload; no PHI leaves VPC during inference.
- Primary constraint: pilot must run inside a VPC with customer-managed keys, and we need a SOC2 evidence packet.

Proposed 4-week POC timeline (compressed) — kickoff week of Aug 9:
1) Week 0 (Aug 9) — Kickoff: environment access, SSO test account, quick dataset handoff (10–20 sample cases).
2) Week 1 (Aug 16) — Integration: ingest pipeline + auth, initial model baseline + latency verification.
3) Week 2 (Aug 23) — Evaluation: run 500-case evaluation, collect tagging precision/recall, tune batching & cache settings.
4) Week 3 (Aug 30) — Readout prep: produce evaluation report + runbook. Final readout with Veridian stakeholders week of Sep 6.

Suggested owners (Redwood):
- Sales / program mgmt: me (Neha) — scheduling, OkRs, financials.
- Solutions engineering: Rishi — integration, test harness, latency tuning.
- Customer success: Marissa — acceptance criteria, readout/reporting, go/no-go recommendation.

Immediate asks (action items):
- Lucas: share SSO test account + minimal sample dataset (10 cases) by Aug 6.
- Veridian legal/Sec: link to SOC2 point-of-contact so we can share the evidence packet.
- Redwood: we will circulate a scoped POC doc and a one-sheet checklist.

Attachments: veridian_poc_scope_v1.pdf (initial scope) and redwood_poc-checklist.xlsx (pilot checklist).

If that all looks good I’ll schedule the kickoff for Tue Aug 10 10am PT and send calendar invites.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Lucas Barnett <lucas@veridianhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@veridianhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 18:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed milestone calendar (next steps)

Thanks Neha — this frames it nicely. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria tweak: instead of 90% absolute match we want an SME-verified "actionable" threshold — essentially, in at least 85% of cases the suggested tags reduce manual triage time by one full step. We can operationalize by timing the triage step in the eval.
- Latency target: 95th under 350ms is acceptable for the pilot given our current infra; please include both the 300ms and 350ms buckets in reports.
- Data: we can provide the 10-case sample by Aug 4; full 500-case eval set will be available by Aug 18 (PHI redacted / synthetic where needed).

Security contact: Jenna Ortiz (j.ortiz@veridianhealth.com) — she’ll coordinate SOC2 access and KMS details.

Kickoff: Tue Aug 10 at 10am PT works for our team. Please send invite.

— Lucas
Director, Clinical Ops | Veridian Health

Marissa / Rishi — moving quickly on this one. Lucas confirmed kickoff Aug 10 10am PT. Key asks so we are ready at kickoff: 

1) Rishi — can you prepare a one-hour integration checklist for VPC onboarding (SSO, KMS handshake, minimal NAT rules) and a lightweight harness to run the 500-case batch? We’ll need an early latency baseline with 10 sample cases during kickoff.
2) Marissa — can you draft the evaluation rubric that maps Veridian's "reduce one triage step" metric to measurable signals (timing measurements, tag accuracy thresholds, false positives)? Use the supplied success criteria tweaks from Lucas.
3) Both — estimate required infra and whether Dedicated or Private is needed for the 4-week pilot (call out any blockers).

I’ve attached the initial scope and checklist that I just shared with Veridian (veridian_poc_scope_v1.pdf, redwood_poc-checklist.xlsx).

I’ll hold scheduling for internal pre-kickoff sync Tue Aug 9 9am PT (30m) — please confirm availability.

Neha

All — confirmed. Quick reply with owners and next steps from Redwood: 

Owners: 
- Integration & latency testing: Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai) — will deliver integration checklist + test harness by Aug 9 EOD.
- Evaluation rubric & readout: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) — will draft rubric and report template by Aug 13.
- Program oversight / scheduling: Neha Kapoor — single thread for calendar + commercial questions.

Pre-kickoff plan (Aug 9 internal sync 9am PT):
- 0–10m: roles, calendar, access checklist
- 10–35m: integration plan (Rishi) and expected infra (Dedicated vs Private)
- 35–45m: evaluation plan & metrics (Marissa)
- 45–60m: immediate blockers + next steps (Neha)

Infra note: Rishi ran a quick estimation — pilot should run in Private (VPC) given the KMS requirement; small Dedicated pool is possible but will add procurement time. We’ll put options in the scope doc for Veridian to decide.

I’ll post the draft rubric to the shared doc in the related_links and circulate before Aug 13. Neha — I’ll accept the calendar invite for Aug 10 kickoff after our internal sync.

Thanks —
